blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval stone wall segment constructed from rough-hewn grey and tan ashlar masonry. It features a wider dark stone base course with slight moss accents at the joints, an irregular main block wall face, a rounded stone relief window or crest emblem on one side, a projecting flat stone coping along the top edge, and a central raised square stone post or merlon cap in the middle. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous with no hovering, melted, or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular coping profile with a square raised cap protruding slightly wider at the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.1 times as tall as the figure to the central post (around 6.5 ft tall) and slightly narrower than the figure is tall (around 4.5 ft wide).
